## Description

Estimate near-term price pressure from asymmetry between bid and ask depth or order-flow events.

## Where it may fit

Very liquid electronic markets where order-book state predicts short-horizon price changes.

## Vehicles

Market makers, intraday stat-arb and high-frequency trading firms.

## Required data

Level-2 depth or order-by-order messages, trades, timestamps, queue changes, fees, latency and spread.

## Caveats

Requires high-quality low-latency data; spoofing, hidden liquidity and queue position complicate signals.
